system.description: Usage held in 1 hand; Activate Interact (2 AP). Terrain: celestial gardens and divine demesnes. Divine nectar gathers in the chalices of celestial flowers that bloom only within the gardens of divine demesnes. A single luminous drop holds shifting colours and gives off the scent of whatever the observer associates with perfect health. It cannot be diluted or divided: lesser vessels crack around it, and any portion smaller than a complete dose evaporates as harmless golden mist. When consumed, you regain all Hit Points and Power Points, reduce Dying to 0, stop all bleeding, and remove the Drained, Fatigued, Frightened, Sickened, Stunned and Weakened conditions. You may also attempt an immediate new saving throw against one disease or poison affecting you. Divine Nectar cannot restore Conviction, reverse death, remove an Injury or end a permanent effect. Pillars of Faith, Chapter 6.

effects.text: Drained is not a condition the sheet tracks — clear it by hand if your table uses it. It cannot restore Conviction, reverse death, remove an Injury or end a permanent effect.
